title: HB1649 (2019-2020 Regular): Establishing an exemption from background check requirements for firearms sales or transfers between concealed pistol license holders.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States public data converted to LegiScan layout (gun-policy Stage 5, Washington); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Washington Legislature text (Introduced, https://lawfilesext.leg.wa.gov/Biennium/2019-20/Htm/Bills/House%20Bills/1649.htm, downloaded directly)
provenance.note: Introduced version. Change is new subsection (4)(j); the rest of RCW 9.41.113 is reprinted unchanged, and the bill strikes only the word 'or' at the end of (4)(h) and moves it to (4)(i).

operative_text:
Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.113): (1) All firearm sales or transfers, in whole or part in this state including without limitation a sale or transfer where either the purchaser or seller or transferee or transferor is in Washington, shall be subject to background checks unless specifically exempted by state or federal law.
Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.113): (4) This section does not apply to:
Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.113): (i) A sale or transfer when the purchaser or transferee is a licensed collector and the firearm being sold or transferred is a curio or relic; or
Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.113): (j) The sale or transfer of a firearm where the seller or transferor and the purchaser or transferee both possess a valid Washington state concealed pistol license
